scope: TRAIN-only oracle-window coverage and visual/domain diagnostic; never production or generalization evidence
selection: identical seeded 4+4 TRAIN source hashes from PANEL-01
negative_window: One-to-one seeded pairing with positive relative timestamp, clamped to each negative duration. Never treat missing negative timestamp as zero.
coverage_definition: Fraction of selected positive point annotations with an actual decoded sampled PTS within tolerance. Not event/evidence relevance.

features.question: Are loose banknotes or coins visible on a work surface?
Do the panels show hands counting or sorting banknotes or coins?
Do the panels show cash moving between two different people's hands?
Does a person move away from the seated workstation across the panels?
Is a cash drawer, safe, or cash-storage door visibly open?
Is a wrapped or sealed cash bundle visible?
Are two or more people visible on the staff side of the counter?
Is someone visibly holding a mobile phone?

feature_pooling: For each question, yes if any panel yes; otherwise unclear if any panel unclear; otherwise no. This pooling is not a violation verdict.

head.validation: LeaveOneGroupOut on automatic groups within the reused TRAIN diagnostic only; train fit reported separately; no parameter search

runtime: same official Qwen3-VL-4B Q4_K_M + F16 projector, llama.cpp b11712 CUDA12.4, panel4
gate_comparison: Regular gate reused from frozen PANEL-01; oracle uses identical legal gate prompt once on oracle/pseudo windows. No legal judgment requested in feature questions.
stopping_rule: No prompt/threshold/features/seed changes after registration. No TUNE or HOLDOUT, irrespective of results. No new production path accepted on these measurements alone.
privacy: All raw answers, windows, features and labels stay in .private. Stdout only phase counts and aggregate matrices, point coverage and timing.
